title: Dimension of a finite-dimensional vector space
statement: Let $K$ be a field and $V$ a finite-dimensional $K$-vector space [def-weil-finite-dimensional-subspace]. The dimension $\dim_KV\in\mathbf Z_{\geq0}$ is the number of elements of a basis of $V$, i.e. of a family of elements of $V$ that is linearly independent over $K$ and spans $V$; any two bases of $V$ have the same number of elements, so $\dim_KV$ does not depend on the basis.
